recipes.name: Wardfrost Tonic
recipes.description: The first brew the tower can supply end to end: frost off its own glass, fungus from under its own cells.
recipes.lore_note: Nothing in this one came from the valley. The keeper seems to have wanted at least one recipe that owed the town nothing.

recipes.name: Stillkeeper Tonic
recipes.description: Three cold, settled things and nothing to hurry them. Lyra uses it on creatures that have been frightened badly enough to stop eating.
recipes.lore_note: It cannot be rushed and it cannot be brewed warm, which is the whole of the method.

recipes.name: Coldiron Tincture
recipes.description: One hand's width of lichen, drawn out three ways with reedwater. The method exists because the ingredient cannot be hurried and there is no second patch.
recipes.lore_note: Brin has said twice that the lichen takes a decade to cover a hand's width. He said it the second time while watching somebody reach for it, which is a different sentence.

recipes.name: Rimeflower Cordial
recipes.description: The high stone's whole winter in a bottle: a flower that is open for a fortnight, the crust that grows beside it, and moss from a valley that has never seen either.
recipes.lore_note: It can only be made in the weeks the flower is open, and the flower has been opening up there unwatched for longer than the tower has stood. Brewing it is the first time anything has come of it.

discovery_milestones.title: A Fortnight Wide
discovery_milestones.text: It can only be made in the weeks the flower is open, which is the first formula in the book that the calendar can close. Worth planning a winter around, which is not a sentence anyone in this valley has had cause to write before.

recipes.name: Twicegiven Tonic
recipes.description: The creature that empties the water, brewed back into the water it emptied. There is nothing else in it, and that is the entire specification.
recipes.lore_note: Wren wrote the brief in one line: something she can give a patient who has already been given something, without having to know what.

recipes.name: Truemeasure Tonic
recipes.description: Two beads of water that have touched nothing and a sap that will not be hurried, held cold. Nothing in it argues with anything, which is why it comes out the same every time.
recipes.lore_note: Lyra asked for a dose that does not drift and would not be talked out of the word drift. A measure that changes between seasons measures the measure.

recipes.name: Seedhold Solution
recipes.description: The first crop the hedgerow has set in twenty years, held in water off a bed you can finally see, and kept a few degrees under so nothing in it is in a hurry.
recipes.lore_note: Both halves of it are the same fact measured twice — something came back that had been counted and written off. The bottle exists so that the next person does not have to take that on faith.

discovery_milestones.title: The Ground Answered
discovery_milestones.text: Two things came back on their own and neither of them was restored by anybody: a hedgerow that can set seed again because there is something flying to set it, and a lake bed you can see because whatever was holding the silt up stopped. Neither is the tower's doing and both are the tower's argument. The bottle is the first thing anyone has made out of a valley that is going forwards.
